senses.gloss:
m. (-रः)
The thorn apple: see धुस्तर.
E.
धेट् to drink, उरच् affix, deriv. irr.

f. (-की)
A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.)
E.
धा to have, affix ण्वुल्, तन् inserted.

m. (-तुः)
1 A principle or humour of the body, as phlegm, wind, and bile.
2 Any constituent part of the body, as blood, flesh, &c.
3 A primary or elementary substance, viz. earth, water, fire, air, and Ākāśa or atmosphere.
4 The property of a primary element, odour, flavour, colour, touch, and sound.
5 An organ of sense.
6 A mineral, a fossil.
7 A metal.
8 A grammatical root; in Sanskrit this radical performs no other office, and cannot be used as a word without undergoing some change.
E.
धा to possess, to contain, (life, substance, &c.) तुन् aff.

n. (-शं)
Red sulphate of iron.
E.
धातु mineral, and काशीश the green sulphate.

n. (-घ्नं)
Sour gruel, prepared from the fermentation of rice water.
E.
धातु chyle, and घ्न destroying; also similar compounds.

n. (-नं)
Sour gruel: see the last.
E.
धातु, and नाशन injuring.

m. (-पः)
The alimentary juice or chyle.
E.
धातु an essential constituent of the body, and प what cherishes.

f. (-का)
A plant: see धातृपुष्पिका; also धातुपुष्पी.

m. (-त्)
1 A mountain.
2 A robust man.
mfn. (-भृत्)
Promoting the animal secretions.
E.
धातु a mineral, and भृत् what contains.

n. (-कं)
A mineral substance, a sulphuret of iron.
E.
धातु mineral, and माक्षिक the same substance.

f. (-णी)
Borax.
E.
धातु a metal, मृ to perish, in the causal form, णिनि and ङीप् affixes; the borate of soda is generally used in India as a flux.

m. (-कः)
Semen, the seminal fluid.
E.
धातु animal fluid, &c. राज chief, कन् added.

n. (-भं)
Borax.
E.
धातु, and वल्लभ friend, a flux.

m. (-दी)
An assayer, a miner, a mineralogist.
E.
धातु a mineral, वद to speak or describe, affix णिनि.

m. (-री)
Sulphur.
E.
धातु a metal, and वैरिन् an enemy; tarnishing metallic^1 lustre, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-रः)
Green sulphate of iron, or green vitriol.
E.
धातु a mineral, and शेखर crest or chief.

m. (-लः)
Chalk.
E.
धातु a mineral, and उपला stone.

m. (-ता)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 A title of VIṢṆU.
3 A father, a parent.
f. (-त्री)
1 A mother.
2 A foster-mother, a nurse.
3 The earth.
4 Emblick myrobalan.
mfn. (-ता-ती-तृ)
1 A cherisher, a protector, fostering, nourishing.
2 Having, containing, possessing, a possessor, &c.
E.
धा to have, to nourish, &c. affix तृच्.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A saint, also called SANATKUMĀRA.
E.
धातृ BRAHMĀ, and पुत्त्र the son.

f. (-का)
A tree, (Grislea tomentosa, Rox.)
E.
धातृ cherishing, पुष्प a flower, ङीष् added, धातृपुष्पी and कन् added; also without the pleonasm, धातृपुष्पी, f. (-ष्पी).

f. (-का)
Emblick myrobalan.
E.
कन् added to धात्री.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 An actor.
2 A foster-brother.
E.
धात्री a nurse, and पुत्त्र a son.

n. (-लं)
The fruit of the emblic myrobalan^1.
E.
धात्री Phyllanthus emblica, and फल fruit.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-यी)
1 A sort of confidante, a foster-sister so employed.
2 A wet-nurse.
E.
धातृ a nurse, ढक् affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
